description: Orbit Bubble Chart is a powerful Power BI custom visual designed to bring hierarchical data to life through an intuitive and engaging bubble-based layout. Instead of displaying hierarchical information in traditional tables or tree structures, Orbit Bubble Chart organizes parent and child categories into visually connected bubbles, making it easier to explore relationships, proportions, and business structures at a glance. Key benefits: Visualize hierarchical and multi-level data in a compact, engaging layout Clearly distinguish parent categories and their child elements Use bubble size to highlight the relative importance or magnitude of values Explore complex relationships and structures more intuitively Create visually appealing Power BI reports and dashboards Make large hierarchies easier to understand and present Orbit Bubble Chart is ideal for business intelligence, financial analysis, portfolio analysis, organizational structures, product hierarchies, category analysis, sales analysis, and other scenarios where relationships between categories matter. Whether you are analyzing a portfolio of investments, product categories, organizational structures, sales segments, or other hierarchical datasets, Orbit Bubble Chart provides a distinctive way to communicate your data and uncover patterns.
